title: Finite continuous representation and its condensation
statement: For a normed field E and a topological group G, PartialKummer.FiniteRepresentation is a finite-dimensional E-representation with its finite-basis coordinate continuity. Its action is the norm-continuous action on all continuous G-valued parameter families. PartialKummer.Condensation over a normed field F with a specified ring homomorphism E→F records the equivariant condensed internal module together with the sectionwise identification with continuous functions P→F^d for every profinite P, including its scalar and action formulas. This is the finite-basis realization of C(P,F tensor_E M), with rank zero permitted Built from [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], [def-sfb-profinite-coefficient-linearization], [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects].
